fields.pass_ranges: ordered [start,end) global access ranges, including empty passes
fields.image_usage: u32 Vulkan usage flags from reused private conversion
fields.buffer_usage: u32 Vulkan usage flags from reused private conversion
fields.physical_mapping: logical,physical u16,reused,initial_access,payload_tag,external token or null; unset physical=65535 and payload_tag=255
fields.initial_transitions: only reused=false; drain pending once; initial -> first
fields.pre_transitions: one list per pass; predecessor concurrency uses external write classifier; no predecessor only reused=true and initial=0
fields.export_transitions: only when final batch exists; last access or initial -> export access
fields.batches: half-open pass start/end plus export_barriers; only last emitted batch=true
fields.imports: logical IDs with imported source, ownership in payload tag
fields.pool_hits: persistent exact-key LIFO hits; reused marker remains false

not_observed_runtime: canonical JSON emitted by candidate oracle; no full original-entry parity
